api_scope.description: The API scope at which a query is run. Default value: "ANY_API" Possible values: ["ANY_API", "DATASTORE_MODE_API", "MONGODB_COMPATIBLE_API"]

database.description: The Firestore database id. Defaults to '"(default)"'.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

density.description: The density configuration for this index. Possible values: ["SPARSE_ALL", "SPARSE_ANY", "DENSE"]

multikey.description: Optional. Whether the index is multikey. By default, the index is not multikey. For non-multikey indexes, none of the paths in the index definition reach or traverse an array, except via an explicit array index. For multikey indexes, at most one of the paths in the index definition reach or traverse an array, except via an explicit array index. Violations will result in errors. Note this field only applies to indexes with MONGODB_COMPATIBLE_API ApiScope.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

query_scope.description: The scope at which a query is run. Default value: "COLLECTION" Possible values: ["COLLECTION", "COLLECTION_GROUP", "COLLECTION_RECURSIVE"]

skip_wait.description: Whether to skip waiting for the index to be created.

unique.description: Whether it is an unique index. Unique index ensures all values for the indexed field(s) are unique across documents.

fields.description:
The fields supported by this index. The last non-stored field entry is
always for the field path '__name__'. If, on creation, '__name__' was not
specified as the last field, it will be added automatically with the same
direction as that of the last field defined. If the final field in a
composite index is not directional, the '__name__' will be ordered
'"ASCENDING"' (unless explicitly specified otherwise).

fields.array_config.description:
Indicates that this field supports operations on arrayValues. Only one of 'order', 'arrayConfig', 'searchConfig' and
'vectorConfig' can be specified. Possible values: ["CONTAINS"]

fields.order.description:
Indicates that this field supports ordering by the specified order or comparing using =, <, <=, >, >=.
Only one of 'order', 'arrayConfig', 'searchConfig' and 'vectorConfig' can be specified. Possible values: ["ASCENDING", "DESCENDING"]

fields.search_config.description:
Indicates that this field supports text or geo-search operations. Only one of 'order', 'arrayConfig', 'searchConfig' and
'vectorConfig' can be specified.

fields.search_config.geo_spec.description: The specification for building a geo search index for a field.

fields.search_config.geo_spec.geo_json_i.description:
If true, disables GeoJSON indexing for the field. By default, GeoJSON points are indexed.
Firestore GeoPoints are indexed regardless of the value of this field.

fields.search_config.text_spec.description: The specification for building a text search index for a field.

fields.search_config.text_spec.index_spe.description: Specifications for how the field should be indexed. Repeated so that the field can be indexed in multiple ways.
Ways to index the text field value.
How to match the text field value.

fields.vector_config.description:
Indicates that this field supports vector search operations. Only one of 'order', 'arrayConfig', 'searchConfig' and
'vectorConfig' can be specified. Vector Fields should come after the field path '__name__'.

fields.vector_config.dimension.description:
The resulting index will only include vectors of this dimension, and can be used for vector search
with the same dimension.

fields.vector_config.flat.description: Indicates the vector index is a flat index.
